result.summary: The page layout is generally clean and well-structured. The main defect is a meaningless '–0%' discount badge on the pizza card. A minor contrast concern appears in the secondary gray text. Clipped carousel items and content below the fold were excluded as intended.

issues.description: The pizza card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a '–0%' discount badge. A zero percent discount is meaningless and looks like a data or rendering error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is 0%, or display a meaningful label such as a promotion or rating instead.

issues.description: Secondary gray text, such as the delivery fees under the 'Fastest near you' cards and the meta line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', and the inactive bottom navigation labels, appears light gray on white and may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive nav colors to meet WCAG AA contrast of at least 4.5:1 for normal text.
